verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Pipedream hosting its own catalog of per-app MCP servers ("Each app has its own dedicated MCP server") and an app marketplace of Pipedream-built integrations. Nothing documents a way for a developer to publish their own MCP server for others to discover or install. Publishing to a registry is a fair question for a hosted MCP platform, so the axis applies, and the lack of evidence makes this "none".

support.subject: As a developer, I can publish my own MCP server on the platform for distribution, discovery, and installation by others
